title: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk
synopsis: Team Reptile’s graffiti-and-grind street culture action game — retained as the iam8bit and Skybound Games Nintendo Switch physical edition.

catalog.publisher: Team Reptile · physical edition by iam8bit and Skybound Games
catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Bomb Rush Cyberfunk is Team Reptile’s skate-and-tag action game: Red and the crew of Bomb Rush Crew grind, trick, and spray their way across New Amsterdam to take the city back from rival crews and the police. It is an open homage to SEGA’s Jet Set Radio, with music contributed by Hideki Naganuma.

The Dutch studio released it digitally on August 18, 2023, on Nintendo Switch and PC. iam8bit and Skybound Games issued the Switch physical edition on December 5, 2023.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is the iam8bit and Skybound Games physical edition of Bomb Rush Cyberfunk on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released digitally on August 18, 2023 for Nintendo Switch and PC; PlayStation and Xbox versions followed in 2024. The Switch physical edition (HAC-P-A38GA) released December 5, 2023.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by iam8bit and Skybound Games, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
